description: Explain a finding id (e.g. access.blocked, robots.disallowed, schema.software_no_offers) in the given language: what it means, why it matters for AI search and how to fix it.

finding_id.description: Finding id exactly as shown in an audit report, for example access.blocked or llms.missing.
finding_id.title: Finding Id

language.description: Report language as a code such as en, de, fr, es, ja or zh. Defaults to the account language (English without a key); 60 languages are supported.
language.title: Language

name: explain_finding
